title: Agent Decision Record
description: A tamper-evident, hash-chained log entry recording a consequential decision made by an AI agent.

adr_version.description: Schema version. Always '1.0' for this version of the spec.

id.description: UUID v4 uniquely identifying this entry.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing integer within a session. Used with prev_hash to form the hash chain.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous entry in this session's chain ('sha256:<hex>'), or null for the first entry.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this entry was recorded.

session_id.description: Identifies the agent run or conversation session this entry belongs to.

agent_id.description: Identifies the specific agent instance that produced this entry.

actor.description: The entity that made this decision.

type.description: Whether the decision was made by an AI model, a human, or an automated system.

model.description: Model identifier (e.g., 'claude-sonnet-4'). Applicable when type is 'model'.

decision_type.description: Categorizes the nature of the decision for filtering and compliance reporting.

input_context_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full input context (prompt, conversation history, tool outputs) at decision time. The raw context is NOT stored by default — only this hash — to protect sensitive data.

input_context_ref.description: Optional pointer to the redacted or encrypted input context in an external store. Only populated if the deployer explicitly opts in to storing context beyond the hash.

action.description: What the agent decided to do.

description.description: Human-readable description of the action taken.

parameters.description: Structured parameters passed to the tool or action.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool invoked, if applicable.

policy_checks.description: Zero or more policy gates evaluated before/after this action.

detail.description: Optional human-readable explanation of the policy evaluation.

outcome.description: Human-readable description of the result of this decision/action.

human_approval.description: Human-in-the-loop approval record for this decision. Required for EU AI Act Article 14 compliance on high-risk systems.

required.description: Whether human approval was required before this action could proceed.

approver_id.description: Identifier of the human who reviewed this decision.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the human reviewed this decision.

retention_class.description: Tags the applicable regulatory retention requirement. Does not enforce deletion — that is a storage-layer concern. Use this to drive downstream retention policy.

entry_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of this entry's canonical serialization (all fields except entry_hash and signature) concatenated with prev_hash. This is the link in the hash chain.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 digital signature over entry_hash, encoded as 'ed25519:<base64>'. Allows an auditor to verify the signing key produced this entry.
